action-reason.batch_not_draft: preparation starts only from a draft batch
action-reason.claim_review_not_ready: claim review has not opened, or source analysis is still running
action-reason.no_copy_awaiting_review: no localized copy is waiting for review
action-reason.batch_not_ready: the batch is not ready to confirm (Truth must be current and every localized copy approved)
action-reason.batch_terminal: the batch is already closed or cancelled
action-reason.attempts_exhausted: all allowed attempts have been used
action-reason.item_not_retry_wait: only an item waiting for a retry can be retried
action-reason.item_not_paused: only a paused item can be resumed

truth.title: Truth package
truth.subtitle: Persisted market facts and source resolution evidence
truth.degraded: Degraded or missing facts remain visible. Review every market before confirming.
truth.ready: All target markets report ready Truth evidence.
truth.stale-detail: Freshness is {{freshness}}. Historical evidence remains visible, but this batch cannot authorize new provider work. Create a new batch to resolve a new immutable TruthPackage.
truth.no-markets: Truth resolution has not produced market evidence yet.
truth.no-facts: No persisted facts for this market.

skip.on_failure_block: no source resolved it (policy: block, so this market does not run)
skip.on_failure_degrade: no source resolved it (policy: continue degraded)

matrix.title: Batch matrix
matrix.subtitle: Source asset × target market; select a cell for attempt and QC evidence
matrix.empty: Items are created after confirmation. This batch currently has no item attempts.

isolated.blocking-failed: A blocking QC check failed for this attempt. The output stays isolated for audit; it can never be adopted.
isolated.blocked: Adoption blocked: {{count}} frozen checks have not passed yet.
isolated.blocked_one: Adoption blocked: {{count}} frozen check has not passed yet.

item.title: Item attempt & QC

reason.skipped_market_unavailable: Skipped: Truth says the product is not available in this market.
reason.truth_price_unresolved: Not run: this market's price could not be resolved, and the market requires a local price or a price claim was not removed.
reason.truth_market_failed: Not run: this market's Truth failed.
reason.truth_fact_missing_blocked: Not run: a fact this market's Truth policy requires could not be resolved (policy: block).
reason.ineligible_before_dispatch: Paused before the edit call: the source, Truth or approved copy is no longer current.
reason.ineligible_after_dispatch: Paused after the edit call: the source or Truth changed meanwhile. The output stays isolated and was not published.
reason.ineligible_before_publish: Paused before publishing: the source, Truth or approved copy is no longer current. The output stays isolated and was not published.
reason.ineligible_on_resume: Could not continue: the source, Truth or approved copy is no longer current.
reason.deterministic_qc_failed: The edited image failed a blocking check. You can retry the item.
reason.qc_exhausted: The last allowed attempt failed. Create a new batch to try again.
reason.adopted_isolated_output: Published by adopting an isolated output after its checks passed.

next-action.reconcile: Wait for the uncertain call to be reconciled

item.no-qc: No QC evidence recorded for this attempt.
item.stale-binding: stale_truth: this MarketAssetBinding remains visible for lineage, but it is blocked from a new experiment until relocalized from current Truth.
item.child-review: Localized child review starts pending. Source approval and business evidence status were not inherited; this exact version needs human review and a new target-market experiment.

new-batch.title: New batch
new-batch.subtitle: Use a business-qualified exact creative or an eligible historical experiment source, with explicit target markets
new-batch.no-sources: No eligible source is available. Confirm an eligible marketing evidence handoff or a historical experiment decision first.
new-batch.origin-marketing: Marketing: exact ad met its business target
new-batch.marketing-note: User-supplied delivery evidence for this exact creative and recorded conditions. Localization creates a new unvalidated execution; it inherits neither business success nor approval. Real truth and BYOK checks apply before any paid step.
new-batch.missing-context: : the selected source is missing persisted {{fields}}. Complete that immutable source context before creating a batch; no target Market Policy or browser default is used.

workspace.title: Localization control room
workspace.intro: Truth-backed batch review, per-item recovery, QC, cost, and asset lineage.
workspace.role-note: Role: {{role}}. Commands remain subject to server authorization; unavailable actions stay visible with their reason.
workspace.source-title: Source evidence, offer, and batch outcome
workspace.operation-subtitle: Recovered from the persisted batch command timeline after refresh or process restart
workspace.copy-subtitle: Copy origin and evidence stay visible; review failures never disappear
workspace.commands-subtitle: Optimistic concurrency uses the persisted batch revision
workspace.preparation-note: Preparation requires a configured Truth data source. The server operation remains {{operation}}; this UI does not fabricate source credentials.
workspace.select-batch: Select a persisted batch to inspect it.

preparation.title: Truth and claim preparation
preparation.subtitle: The server freezes exact LibraryVersion identities; Controlled Mock replaces only external fact and analysis calls.
preparation.not-ready: Publish an eligible Truth Resolution Policy and Data Source, and ensure every target has an explicit locale, country, and currency before resolving this batch.
preparation.validation-findings: Claim analysis is complete, but the frozen Truth policy does not cover every market-sensitive claim family: {{findings}}. Cancel this batch and create a new one with a complete published policy.
preparation.all-resolved: Every source-market pair has an immutable ClaimDecisionSet.
preparation.analysis-pending: Source analysis is still durable work in progress. Refresh after its Operation completes.
